Hi Georges,

Sorry I am working so I might be able to get back to your emails as fast. I am not sure if you got my last email. But I am also having issues with the Nexus S1 now. It keeps turning on and off. I tried to replace the fuse, but it is still not working. I was also supposed to get 1 more Nexus L1 which never arrived. So, I was wondering If I could just get the instore credit to purchase something else if that is ok instead? Let me know. I have been a long-term customer, and I have only had troubles with these Nexus miners so far. Thanks again Georges.

Oliver M,

Sorry Just to clarify again Georges. I am missing 1x Nexus L1 which never shipped to begin with. I also have 1x not working Nexus L1 and also 1x not working Nexus S1. So, 3 units in total. 2 need RMA and 1 was never shipped.
Passed the chat to support · Oliver asks for store credit instead of the DC06 replacement, and reports 1x Nex

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for laying it out clearly, that helps. Georges and the team are picking up the store credit question and the Nexus L1 that never shipped, and the answer on both will come back to you in this thread today after 10am ET.

On the Nexus S1, one important thing first: please leave it unplugged for now. A unit that blows a fuse is not safe to keep trying, and replacing a fuse that blows again just hides a short.

What I need to work out is whether the fault is in the power supply or on the miner board itself, because "turns on and off" is honestly the symptom of both. The quickest test is a different power supply, as long as it is the same voltage and at least the same amperage as the one that came with the S1. If you have a second Nexus brick or an equivalent one, try that. If the S1 then stays on and boots normally, it was the power supply and we can simply send you a new one, no return needed. If it still cycles on and off with a known-good supply, that points at the board and I will pass it to our hardware lead with my findings.

If you can, send me two things with your reply: a short video of the S1 from the moment you plug it in until it cuts out, including any text or lights on the screen, and a clear photo of the serial label on the unit. With the video I can usually tell from the LED and screen behaviour which of the two it is, even without a spare supply.

To be clear on the L1 from Shop····, nothing changes there, that one is already settled as a fault on our side and Georges is handling how you want it resolved.

If you would like a faster back and forth than email, our Discord is at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and JD, our hardware lead, is @nullhashrate there.

Hal, Technical Support, HeliumDeploy
